comingLast.roast: finished on 18 - the bravest thing now is staying for the presentation
current run rate 1.3 - the presentation script has him pencilled in
the blue balls are patient - 6 holes is nothing to them
1 clear with 5 to play - points only go up, but so does the tension
sitting 3 above Elliott and driving very, very carefully
5 above Elliott and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
safe-ish by 6 - the blue balls have come back from further
done, 6 clear, and suddenly an expert on everyone else's back nine
7 clear and finished - now a full-time Elliott supporter
